caption: The drawing features two wooden containers, both depicted in shades of green and brown. The larger container is drawn in the foreground and has an oval shape with a fitted lid and a central handle. The lid appears to be slightly domed, and the container is ornamented with small decorative markings on its sides and around its seams, including zigzag and chevron patterns. Vertical stitching or fastenings are visible on one side, presumably to hold the structure together. Two small protrusions extend vertically from the rim on opposite sides. Above this, in the upper left part of the drawing, a smaller container of the same general color and design is shown, but with its lid open, revealing the unfinished wood on the inside as well as a diagonal support or divider. The containers rest on an off-white background with no additional objects present.
title: Pa. German Bride's Hat Box
